note: boss phase 2: heavier, faster, more intense than phase 1
note_evidence: The track delivers high intensity with heavy distorted bass and rapid vocal chops starting at 0:03, fitting an enraged boss phase, though brief vocal-only sections at 0:10 and 0:24 slightly drop the pressure.
beat_evidence: A fast, aggressive kick and clear rhythmic vocal chops establish a highly tappable pulse from the very first second.
loop_evidence: While it starts with immediate energy, the track features a distinct fade-out at 0:38 instead of a seamless loop, making it unsuitable for continuous looping without editing.
